{{Spoiler}}

A '''braised warped fungus''' is the simple preparation of the [[Warped Fungus|warped fungus]], a secret [[ingredient]]. It heals {{Value|Braised Warped Fungus|heals}} and gives {{EffectLink|Invisibility}} for {{Value|Braised Warped Fungus|duration|effect=Invisibility}}.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/food/oven/brasied_warped_fungus.json}}</ref>

== Obtaining ==

=== Cooking ===
{{Recipes}}
The recipe is secret and is never added to the recipe book.

== Usage ==

=== Food ===
Eating it takes {{Value|Braised Warped Fungus|eat_time}}, heals {{Value|Braised Warped Fungus|heals}} and gives Invisibility for {{Value|Braised Warped Fungus|duration|effect=Invisibility|format=clock}}.

It has no crafting use. Cooking one grants ''Hidden Flavors''.
